description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 700 yards to the Beach* Newly Built in 2022!* 3rd Floor Sun Deck* 4 Bikes Included* 2 Blocks from the 12,000 sqft Community Pool* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.***The Lagoon Pool will be resurfaced. This project will take approximately 4 weeks. Start date on this process is Monday, Oct 27th, 2025. The pool deck will be closed during this time as well due to the safety hazards during this project. We anticipate opening the complex on Monday, November 24th, 2025. During this time, our Neighbors at the Village of South Walton will be allowing the use of our wristbands at their pool complex. ***Two Parking passes will be provided. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home.*Land your perfect vacation at The Eagles Nest! This newly built 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath home is located in the popular 30A community of Seacrest Beach. Situated only 700 yards from beach access and easy walking distance to Rosemary Beach, this stunning home features shiplap walls, ceiling beams, a bright white kitchen with granite countertops, and upgrades throughout. The second floor contains a king bed in the master bedroom and a queen bed in the guest room, while the third floor includes a queen bed in the 2nd guest room, and a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk beds. This beautiful home can sleep 10 guests comfortably. Sip your beverage of choice on the 3rd-floor sun deck, take a dip in the huge community pool, or ride the seasonal tram to the beautiful beaches! Come home to roost at The Eagles Nest for your next beach vacation!Seacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000sqft community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Come see why friends and families vacation at Seacrest Beach year after year!Bed Setup:2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom: Queen BedBunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (sleeps 4)Area Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
